description: This file contains test cases for FastAPI application endpoints, including fixture setup and multiple endpoint validation tests, utilizing pytest and FastAPI test client.

methods.name: get_client(request: pytest.FixtureRequest)
methods.description: Fixture that dynamically imports a module based on test parameters, creates and returns a FastAPI TestClient for testing endpoints.

methods.name: test_query_params_str_validations_no_query(client: TestClient)
methods.description: Tests the '/items/' GET endpoint without query parameters, expecting a successful response with a list of items.

methods.name: test_query_params_str_validations_q_fixedquery(client: TestClient)
methods.description: Tests the '/items/' GET endpoint with a fixed query parameter 'q', validating correct response including the query.

methods.name: test_query_params_str_validations_q_fixedquery_too_short(client: TestClient)
methods.description: Tests validation for query parameter 'q' when input is too short; expects a 422 error with validation details.

methods.name: test_openapi_schema(client: TestClient)
methods.description: Validates that the OpenAPI schema returned by the application matches the expected specification.
